title: No private keys required in-process
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 6.2 Key Management; QR Code Generation, 13. Reference script.

statements.label: No private keys required in-process
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL NOT need access to private key material: issuance is prepare, then the caller signs the returned bytes by any means (HSM, KMS, PKCS#11, Android Keystore, WebCrypto), then finish (STT-ISS-004). A software ES256 and PS256 signer SHALL be provided for tests only, in the testkit module.

sources.quote: Use of HSMs for signing health certificates is highly encouraged.
a real issuer holds its private keys in an HSM
